matched: Statistical evaluation of nine remaining input variables following qualitative selection in Section 2.2.2
Identification of significant correlations in SI 3 labeled with circles (p-value < 0.05)
Retention of influent flow rate over effluent flow rate for model simplicity based on >97% flux recovery
Inclusion of TMP to enhance model transferability by accounting for acyclic membrane fouling in long-term operations despite weak nitrification correlation
Exclusion of membrane cleaning record despite correlation with TMP to avoid material-specific biases
Omission of TN due to marginal predictive contribution and impracticality for real-time monitoring (expensive sensors, 30-60 min intervals vs NO3-N/NH4-N)
Final selection of six input features: three operational (air flow rate, influent flow rate, TMP) and three water quality (effluent COD, NO3--N, NH4+-N)
Streamlined feature set balancing model simplicity, accuracy, and field feasibility
